indian_entity: Muslim community of Kollam (Quilon), Malabar Coast
chinese_source: Quilon (Tarisapalli) copper plates — Chera royal charter of Ayyan Adikal under Sthanu Ravi Kulasekhara, witness plate (local epigraphy; the correlation source here is epigraphic, not Chinese)
event: Eleven Muslim witnesses sign, in Kufic Arabic, a royal charter granting privileges to the Christian Tarisapalli church at Kollam, alongside witnesses signing in Pahlavi and Hebrew — a settled Muslim community of charter-witnessing standing exists at Kollam
date_raw: 5th regnal year of Sthanu Ravi Kulasekhara (Kollam era 24/25)
firmness_reason: Dated royal charter, extant plates; the standard epigraphic dating of the Tarisapalli grant
notes: Earliest FIRM attestation of a Muslim community on the Malabar coast. The signatures attest a community, not a mosque building; no mosque at Kollam or Kodungallur is dated by this document.
references: Quilon Syrian copper plates (849 CE), plate 5 witness signatures
Narayanan, M. G. S., Perumals of Kerala (1996/2013)
